questions.question: What is the correct order of how a search engine works?
options: Ranking → Indexing → Crawling
Crawling → Indexing → Ranking
Indexing → Crawling → Ranking
Ranking → Crawling → Indexing
questions.explanation: Search engines first crawl (discover pages via links), then index (store and organize content), and finally rank (order results by relevance and quality).

questions.question: A keyword has 12,000 monthly search volume and 85 Keyword Difficulty (KD). What does this mean for a new blog?
options: Target it immediately — high volume means guaranteed traffic
High volume but very competitive — a new site should target lower KD keywords first
KD doesn't matter if the content is good
The keyword is too popular to ever rank for
questions.explanation: KD of 85 means top-ranking pages have strong backlink profiles. New sites should start with KD below 30-40 and build authority before targeting high-KD terms.

questions.question: Which of the following is a 'transactional' search intent keyword?
options: What is digital marketing
Digital marketing course fees in Delhi
History of SEO
Buy digital marketing course online with certificate
questions.explanation: Transactional intent means the user wants to take action (buy, sign up, download). 'Buy digital marketing course online' clearly shows purchase intent.

questions.question: What is the recommended length for a title tag in SEO?
options: 10-20 characters
50-60 characters
100-150 characters
200+ characters
questions.explanation: Title tags should be 50-60 characters to display fully in Google search results. Longer titles get truncated with '...' which reduces click-through rates.

questions.question: A website's page loads in 8 seconds. How does this affect SEO?
options: Speed doesn't affect SEO at all
It's a positive signal — Google prefers slower sites
It hurts rankings because Core Web Vitals penalize slow-loading pages, and users bounce
Only mobile speed matters, not desktop
questions.explanation: Page speed is a ranking factor. Google's Core Web Vitals measure loading performance (LCP should be under 2.5s). Slow pages also increase bounce rate, further hurting rankings.

questions.question: What does the robots.txt file do?
options: It creates robots that automatically write content
It tells search engine crawlers which pages they can or cannot access/crawl
It speeds up your website loading time
It blocks hackers from accessing your site
questions.explanation: Robots.txt is a text file at your site's root that instructs search engine bots which URLs they're allowed or disallowed from crawling. It doesn't guarantee pages won't be indexed.

questions.question: Which Core Web Vital measures the largest content element loading time?
options: FID (First Input Delay)
CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift)
LCP (Largest Contentful Paint)
TTFB (Time to First Byte)
questions.explanation: LCP (Largest Contentful Paint) measures how long the biggest visible element (hero image, headline) takes to load. Google recommends LCP under 2.5 seconds.

questions.question: Internal linking in SEO helps by:
options: Making your website look more colorful
Distributing page authority, helping crawlers discover content, and improving user navigation
Replacing the need for external backlinks entirely
Automatically boosting your Domain Authority by 50 points
questions.explanation: Internal links pass authority between pages, help Google's crawler discover and understand site structure, and keep users engaged by guiding them to related content.

questions.question: A bakery in Mumbai wants more local customers. Which SEO action should they prioritize?
options: Write a blog about bakeries in Paris
Create and optimize their Google Business Profile with photos, reviews, and correct NAP
Buy 1,000 backlinks from random websites
Target keywords like 'how to bake bread at home'
questions.explanation: Local SEO starts with Google Business Profile — correct Name, Address, Phone (NAP), photos, business hours, and encouraging customer reviews for local pack visibility.

questions.question: What is Domain Rating (DR) or Domain Authority (DA)?
options: A Google-official ranking score from 1-100
A third-party metric (by Ahrefs/Moz) estimating a website's backlink strength on a 0-100 scale
The age of a domain in years
The number of pages on a website
questions.explanation: DR (Ahrefs) and DA (Moz) are third-party metrics that estimate backlink profile strength. They're not official Google metrics but help compare site authority.

questions.question: Which HTML tag is MOST important for on-page SEO?
options: <footer>
<title>
<div>
<span>
questions.explanation: The <title> tag is the most important on-page SEO element — it appears in search results as the clickable blue link and heavily influences rankings and CTR.

questions.question: Schema markup (structured data) helps search engines by:
options: Making your website load faster
Providing explicit information about page content so search engines can show rich results
Blocking competitors from copying your content
Automatically translating your site into multiple languages
questions.explanation: Schema markup is code that gives search engines explicit context about your content (recipes, reviews, events, FAQs), enabling rich snippets in search results.

questions.question: An XML sitemap is important because:
options: It makes your website design look better
It helps search engines discover and crawl all important pages on your site efficiently
It replaces the need for robots.txt
It directly improves your ranking position
questions.explanation: An XML sitemap lists all important URLs on your site, helping search engine crawlers find pages — especially useful for large sites or pages with few internal links.

questions.question: Which type of backlink is most valuable for SEO?
options: A link from a random blog comment
A contextual dofollow link from a high-authority relevant website
100 links from the same low-quality directory
A link hidden in white text on a page
questions.explanation: A dofollow link from a relevant, high-authority site passes the most 'link juice.' Quality and relevance matter far more than quantity in modern SEO.

questions.question: What is 'keyword cannibalization'?
options: Using too many keywords in one page
When multiple pages on your site compete for the same keyword, confusing Google about which to rank
Stealing keywords from competitors
When a keyword becomes too expensive in Google Ads
questions.explanation: Keyword cannibalization occurs when two or more pages target the same keyword, splitting authority and confusing Google about which page deserves to rank.

questions.question: Google Search Console is used to:
options: Design your website layout
Monitor search performance, fix indexing issues, submit sitemaps, and check Core Web Vitals
Buy Google Ads
Create social media posts
questions.explanation: Google Search Console is a free tool showing how Google sees your site — search queries, click data, indexing status, mobile usability, and Core Web Vitals reports.

questions.question: A page has good content but isn't ranking. The meta description is 350 characters long. What should you fix?
options: Nothing — longer meta descriptions rank better
Shorten it to 150-160 characters with the target keyword and a compelling CTA
Remove the meta description entirely
Add more keywords by making it 500 characters
questions.explanation: Meta descriptions should be 150-160 characters. Longer ones get truncated in search results. While not a direct ranking factor, good meta descriptions improve CTR.

questions.question: CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift) measures:
options: How fast the first byte loads
How much page content unexpectedly moves/shifts while loading
The total number of CSS files on a page
How many clicks it takes to reach a page
questions.explanation: CLS measures visual stability — unexpected layout shifts (like images loading and pushing text down) frustrate users. Google recommends CLS score below 0.1.

questions.question: For a local business in India, NAP consistency means:
options: Taking a nap before writing content
Having the exact same Name, Address, and Phone number across all online listings and directories
Using as many different addresses as possible for variety
Only listing your business on one platform
questions.explanation: NAP (Name, Address, Phone) consistency across Google Business Profile, Justdial, Sulekha, your website, and all directories builds trust with search engines for local rankings.

questions.question: A coaching institute in Jaipur wants to rank for 'best coaching classes in Jaipur.' Which combination of SEO strategies is MOST effective?
options: Only write blogs about coaching in Mumbai and Delhi
Optimize Google Business Profile, get student reviews, create location-specific pages, and build local citations
Buy 10,000 backlinks from a freelancer on Fiverr
Just add the keyword 50 times on the homepage
questions.explanation: Local SEO requires a multi-pronged approach: optimized GBP, genuine reviews, location-specific content, and citations on Indian directories like Justdial and Sulekha.
